Trace, implement and test: leetcode371 sum of two integers bit op iterative

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int getSum(int a, int b) {
        unsigned int carry;
        while (b != 0) /* 把b先拿过去与a相加(&运算求出进位值, 异或^求出和的不进位部分), 后面用b存储每一次的进位值 */
        {
            carry = (unsigned long)(a & b) << 1; /* 单独处理进位, unsigned long有时可以换成unsigned int */
            a ^= b;                              /* 对位相加, 不处理进位的部分 */
            b = carry;
        }
        return a;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    int a = 10;
    int b = -3;
    auto res = sol.getSum(a, b);
    cout << res << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
